         Multipart response headers generator.
 
         ```
-        --{boundary}\n
-        Content-Type: {content_type}\n
-        Content-Range: bytes {start}-{end-1}/{max_size}\n
-        \n
-        ..........content...........\n
-        --{boundary}\n
-        Content-Type: {content_type}\n
-        Content-Range: bytes {start}-{end-1}/{max_size}\n
-        \n
-        ..........content...........\n
-        --{boundary}--\n
+        --{boundary}\r\n

+        Content-Range: bytes {start}-{end-1}/{max_size}\r\n
+        \r\n
+        ..........content...........\r\n
+        --{boundary}\r\n
+        Content-Type: {content_type}\r\n
+        Content-Range: bytes {start}-{end-1}/{max_size}\r\n
+        \r\n
+        ..........content...........\r\n
+        --{boundary}--\r\n
         ```
         """
-        boundary_len = len(boundary)
-        static_header_part_len = 44 + boundary_len + len(content_type) + len(str(max_size))
+        def header_generator(start: int, end: int) -> bytes:
+            return (
+                f"--{boundary}\r\n"
+                f"Content-Type: {content_type}\r\n"
+                f"Content-Range: bytes {start}-{end - 1}/{max_size}\r\n"
+                "\r\n"
+            ).encode("latin-1")
+
         content_length = sum(
-            (len(str(start)) + len(str(end - 1)) + static_header_part_len)  # Headers
-            + (end - start)  # Content
-            for start, end in ranges
-        ) + (
-            5 + boundary_len  # --boundary--\n
-        )
-        return (
-            content_length,
-            lambda start, end: (
-                f"--{boundary}\nContent-Type: {content_type}\nContent-Range: bytes {start}-{end - 1}/{max_size}\n\n"
-            ).encode("latin-1"),
+            len(header_generator(start, end)) + (end - start) + len(b"\r\n") for start, end in ranges
         )
+        content_length += len(f"--{boundary}--\r\n".encode("latin-1"))
+        return content_length, header_generator
